method: Offline exhaustive finite-grid search of a causal feedback rule; no claim of global continuous optimum or MPC
design_score: Equal-scenario mean energy ratio: candidate terminal energy plus positive excess terminal battery heat versus baseline divided by COP (ambient >=25C only), plus absolute terminal cabin difference correction divided by min(COP,heater efficiency), then divided by baseline energy
constraints_note: Comfort, safety, dwell, compressor budget, regen settings and preconditioning are declared engineering assumptions, not organizer-provided certified ratings.
information_note: Controller uses current simulated/sensed state, current ambient and planned remaining trip time; no future speed. Terminal return assumes a known planned arrival time.
thermal_accounting_note: Terminal heat correction is an idealized accounting diagnostic, not an actual continuation simulation or proof of long-run saving. Report raw energy and corrected energy, temperatures and comfort deviation together.
